order_basis: The EEGxPlore preprocessing drops M1, M2, VEO, and HEO.
The preprocessing then preserves the source CNT channel order.
This list follows the canonical SEED-V 62-channel montage order published by TorchEEG.
unverified_items: The original CNT files are not available on this filesystem.
The current LMDB does not store raw channel names or preprocessing metadata.
The LMDB records use a legacy schema and therefore cannot independently prove this order.
